arguments.query: select b.*, (select group_concat(charge_id||":"||idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b
select charge_id,booking_id,state,amount_cents,idempotency_key from charges where booking_id not in (select booking_id from bookings where status="confirmed")
select booking_id from bookings where status="pending"
select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,c.state,(select count(*) from outbox) ob from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status!="confirmed" or c.state!="captured"
select f.flight_id,f.capacity,(select count(*) from holds h where h.flight_id=f.flight_id) h,(select count(*) from bookings b where b.flight_id=f.flight_id and status="pending") p from flights f
select status,count(*) n from outbox group by status

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.client_reference,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured") cap,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select count(*) from customer_events e where e.booking_id=b.booking_id) ev from bookings b where not (b.status="confirmed" and cap=1 and h=1 and k=1)
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("customer_events","refunds","outbox")

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.request_id,(select count(*) from customer_events e where e.request_id=b.request_id) ev from bookings b where b.status!="confirmed" or b.booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings b2 where not exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b2.booking_id))
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n,max(rowid) r from request_logs where status>=400 group by 1,2,3,4 order by r desc limit 10
